notes:
I don't have any notes for you yet. My tools hit their usage limit before I could read a single page, so I have no sources for Ezekiel 16:1–21.

Your rules say to report only what the pages I read actually say, with a URL for every point. Writing notes now would mean filling them in from memory without citations, so I've left them out.

**What I'll do when you ask again:** I'll read the pages one at a time, starting with these:

- **Verse-by-verse traditional readings:**
  - enduringword.com/bible-commentary/ezekiel-16/
  - biblehub.com/commentaries/ezekiel/16-[verse].htm for Gill, Ellicott, the Pulpit Commentary and others
  - studylight.org commentaries
  - preceptaustin.org's Ezekiel 16 page
- **Protestant traditions:**
  - Reformed: ligonier.org, thegospelcoalition.org
  - Baptist: desiringgod.org, gty.org, spurgeon.org (Spurgeon preached on v. 6, "Live!")
  - Methodist: wesley.nnu.edu (Wesley's Notes)
  - Lutheran: lcms.org, 1517.org
  - Pentecostal: pneumareview.com, samstorms.org
- **Other views:**
  - Modern scholarship: netbible.org translator notes (especially on vv. 4, 6, 8, 16 and 20–21) and bibleodyssey.org
  - Catholic and Orthodox: newadvent.org (Church Fathers), catholic.com, oca.org

To fit within the limits, I could go in smaller batches, such as vv. 1–7, then 8–14, then 15–21. Just say "continue" or name a batch.
